Bacon Potato Pea Soup Recipe

Fry up 1lb bacon, leave about half the bacon grease in the bottom of your pot. Set the bacon aside.
Dice 1 onion, 4 carrots, and a head of celery. Sauté them in the bacon grease until the onion is clear. Add 5 cloves minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Then sprinkle 1 cup of flour over the veggies and mix together. 
Add 16 oz of heavy cream. Once everything has had a chance to heat up and mix together, add 96 oz of chicken broth. Turn the heat up and bring this to a boil. 
Add 6 peeled and diced potatoes. Let this boil until your potatoes are soft. Turn the heat off before your potatoes get too soft, you don’t want them to be mush. 
Salt and pepper to taste. I also add garlic salt and onion powder to taste.
Chop your bacon and add that back to your pot. 
Add a small frozen bag of peas.
If your soup is too thick add water or broth. 
If your soup is too runny, in a bowl whisk a 1/2 cup flour with a few cups of the soup broth. Once smooth, add to your pot and stir together.

Broccoli Cheddar Soup Recipe
Ingredients 
7 cups chicken broth
3 potatoes, peeled and cubed
3 bunches broccoli heads, cut into bite-size pieces (should yield 10 cups)
4 cloves of garlic, minced
1 large onion, diced
1 bunch celery, chopped, use the leafy part too
¼ cup butter
For thickening:
½ cup butter
½ cup flour
6 cups milk (or half and half)
6 cups shredded cheese salt and pepper, to taste

Clean and chop your broccoli, set aside. Peel and dice your potatoes, and add them to a pot. Cover with chicken broth and bring to a boil. Let boil for 5 min. Add your broccoli, continue to boil until the potatoes are just barely soft. Turn your heat off.
In a separate pan, sauté onion and celery in ¼ cup butter. When the onion is translucent add your garlic. Let cook until fragrant, then add to your pot.
In a separate pan (I use the one I just sautéed the onion in) on medium heat, melt ½ cup butter, then whisk in flour. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth. Add cheese and whisk slowly until smooth. Fold in carefully to your big pot, stirring carefully to avoid breaking up the vegetables. Salt and pepper.

White Chicken Chili
In a crockpot add:
4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 yellow onion diced
5 cloves garlic minced
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp cayenne pepper
2 4oz cans diced green chiles
Pour in enough chicken broth to cover everything. About 24oz
Cook on High for 3-4 hours
Shred the chicken
Then add 4 oz cream cheese
2 cups cream
1 bunch chopped cilantro
2 15oz can whole kernel corn. I don’t always drain the cans
2 15oz cans great Northern beans drained and rinsed
The juice of 2 limes
Salt and Pepper. Using a high quality salt makes a big difference.
Turn your crockpot to low and let everything simmer together for about 30 minutes or until the cream cheese is creamy and smooth. If it’s too thick you can add more broth or water.

I made soup for the masses! Here is a recipe that will serve 6.  I like to add different types of tomatoes when making a soup. If you are making this as a dip I only add cherry tomatoes, I don't blend it smooth. I take a fork and mash it a little after you take it out of the oven, then use bread to dip with.

Tomato Soup Recipe
In a roasting pan add about 24 oz container of tomatoes. The more tomatoes you use, the more soup you will make. 
Sometimes I add a yellow onion and red bell pepper
Drizzle with Olive Oil
Season with Salt, Pepper, and Oregano
Cut the top off a bulb of garlic, exposing the cloves, set it cut-side down in the pan
Roast in the oven at 400 degrees for about 25 min or until the tomatoes blister
Remove the garlic bulb and squeeze out the softened garlic cloves
Add burrata cheese, slice down the center to open
drizzle with balsamic glaze
sprinkle on fresh chopped basil
at this point you can serve as a dip, or use a blender and blend until smooth and serve as a soup.

I like to add two bulbs of garlic when roasting, one for the soup, and one to make a compound for grilled cheese.

Butter Compound
1 stick of soften butter
1 bulb of roasted garlic smashed
1 tsp rosemary, thyme, basil, parsley, 
mix it all up and spread on your grilled cheese.

Potato Soup Recipe

Fry up 1lb bacon, leave about half the bacon grease in the bottom of your pot. Set the bacon aside.
Dice 1 onion, 4 carrots, and a head of celery. Sauté them in the bacon grease until the onion is clear. Add 5 cloves minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Then sprinkle 1 cup of flour over the veggies and mix together. Then add 16 oz of heavy cream. Once everything has had a chance to heat up and mix together add 96 oz of chicken broth. Turn the heat up and bring this to a boil. 
Add 6 peeled and diced potatoes. Turn the heat off before your potatoes get too soft, you don’t want them to be mush. 
Salt and pepper to taste. I also add garlic salt and onion powder to taste.
Chop your bacon and add that to your pot. 
Add a small frozen bag of peas.
If your soup is too thick add water or broth. 
If your soup is too runny, in a bowl whisk a 1/2 cup flour with a few cups of the soup broth. Once smooth, add to your pot and stir together.

Mississippi Pot Roast
Sear a large chuck roast on all sides in butter. Add it to a crockpot. 
In that same pan sautee an onion once almost clear add 6 cloves of minced garlic and sautee till fragrant. Then add to your crockpot on top of the seared roast.
Add a bottle of sliced mild pepperoncinis juice and all (spice level 5)
Mix in packet of au jus gravy mix

Cook on low for 8-10 hours. The longer the better.

How to Clean Your Seashells
Let your shells soak in bleach water over night
Use a wire scrub brush to scrub them and rinse with water
If they have barnacles on them use a file or dremel to remove them
Dip the shells in muriatic acid for a few seconds then dip in water to neutralize 
Once dried spray with an acrylic spray paint

How to clean sand dollars
Rinse with water
Soak in bleach water for 10 min to an hour checking on them frequently 
Lay out in the sun to naturally bleach and air dry

Tomato Sauce Recipe
Sauté Onion in Olive oil
Add 5 cloves minced Garlic till fragrant (30 sec)
28oz canned tomatoes (I used 1 quart home canned)
1/2 bunch of chopped fresh basil
1/2 bunch of chopped fresh Parsley
2 tsp Oregano
1 tsp Garlic powder
Salt & Pepper
Stir and Bring to a boil
Blend it if you want it smooth 


Meatballs
In a bowl add
2lbs ground beef (you can do half sausage if you want)
Two eggs
salt & pepper
1 tsp  garlic powder
1 tsp  onion powder
1/3 cup of breadcrumbs 
In a blender blend together 1 white onion
5 cloves  garlic 
1/2 bunch of fresh basil
1/2 bunch of fresh parsley
Then add the blender mixture to your bowl and combined everything. If the mixture is thick you can add a splash of milk.
 
Make into small balls and put them on a cookie sheet. Bake at 375°F for 10 min then flip and cook for 5 more min

Add meatballs to the tomato sauce and you are ready to use over pasta, veggies, or in a meatball sub, etc. 
The meat balls freeze really well, so does the sauce.

Kale Crunch Salad
In a bowl add 1 bunch Kale chopped (wash thoroughly)
The zest of one lemon
Add dressing and massage. This is crucial.
Add 3/4 cup grated parm
In a pan toast 1/3 cup pine nuts and a 1/2 cup panko crumbs in 1 tsp avocado oil till brown, then add to your salad and mix!

DRESSING
In a blender mix 1/3 cup avocado oil
1/4 cup honey
1 lemon, juiced
4 slices jalapeño, seeds removed
1 tsp dijon mustard
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp ground pepper

I ate this all summer long! You could add chicken or steak to make it more hearty and filling.

Link to Gorgeous Pan: https://amzn.to/3GiZrMb
Dutch Oven Potatoes
1 pound bacon, cut into 1-inch lengths
1 onion, chopped
½ cup butter
8 russet potatoes cut into ¼-inch slices (peeled or unpeeled-your preference, I like unpeeled)
8 ounces sour cream
12 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded

Fry bacon in a dutch oven until crisp (don’t put the lid on or the bacon will never get crispy)
Remove bacon but leave the grease. 
Fry the onion in the bacon grease until it becomes clear. 
Add butter and potatoes into the pan. salt and pepper, to taste.
Bake for 60 min @350° or until the potatoes are soft
mix in bacon, sour cream, and cheese.

Bread Recipe
Ingredients
3 tablespoons yeast
1 tablespoon sugar
1 cup warm water
10 cups flour
½ cup sugar
1 tablespoon salt
½ cup olive oil
3 cups warm water

MIXING AND KNEADING STAGE
In a small bowl, mix yeast with sugar, then add 1 cup warm water. Stir until dissolved. Let rise until doubled (about 10 minutes). Sometimes I forget it and it crawls out onto my counter.
In a large mixing bowl, 10 cups flour, ½ cup sugar, and salt.
In the center of the flour, pour the yeast mixture and add oil and 3 cups warm water. Mix together with a long-handled wooden spoon. It will look pretty shaggy. Use your hands to get the dough off the sides of the bowl. Let the dough rest for 15 minutes. I find that this is a perfect time to wash my hands and tidy up my kitchen.
Knead dough until the texture is consistent and smooth throughout. This only takes a few minutes.
Let the dough rise in a warm area with a light cotton cloth over the bowl. When it has doubled in size (approximately 1 hour), punch the dough down. At this point, you can either let it rise again for another hour or make it into loaves. A second rising makes for lighter loaves.
BAKING STAGE
Punch dough down. Cut dough into 4 equal sections. Shape each dough section into a loaf. Place in four greased 9x5-inch loaf pans. Cover with a cloth, and let rise about 45 minutes, or until dough is doubled and about an inch above the top of the tin.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

Banana Bread Bars with a Brown Butter Glaze
1-1/2 c. sugar
1 c. sour cream
1/2 c. butter, softened
2 eggs
4 ripe bananas, mashed
2 tsp. vanilla extract
2 c. all purpose flour
1 tsp. baking soda
3/4 tsp. salt

Brown Butter Frosting:
1/2 c. butter (I used my Dads Homemade)
4 c. powdered sugar
1-1/2 tsp. vanilla extract
3 tbsp. milk

Directions:
1.  Heat oven to 375F.  Grease and flour 15x10-inch jelly roll pan.  For the bars, in a large bowl, beat together sugar, sour cream, butter, then beat in eggs and vanilla until creamy.  Blend in bananas.  Add flour, baking soda, salt, and blend.

2.  Spread batter evenly into pan.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

3.  For the frosting, heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat until boiling.  Let the butter turn a delicate brown and remove from heat immediately.

4.  Add powdered sugar, vanilla extract and milk.  Whisk together until smooth.  Using a spatula, spread the brown butter frosting over the warm bars.

Picadillo Recipe 
In a pot cook 2lbs ground beef and 1 diced yellow onion. Salt & Pepper, drain grease.
Add 4 diced potatoes
1 chopped green bell pepper
4 largely chopped Roma tomatoes
5 gloves of minced garlic
12oz can of tomato paste
7 oz can roasted chilis
30 oz beef broth
2 tsp cumin
2 tsp coriander
2 bay leaves 
Mix well and let simmer until potatoes are soft.
If you want it more like a soup add more broth. You can eat it with tortillas, over rice, or like a stew using less broth.
Sometimes I add a bag of frozen peas and carrots if I need it to go farther.
Top with sour cream and avocado.

Rice Krispie Rolls
In a pan melt 1 stick of butter
Add one package of marshmallows and stir until it’s all melted together.
Mix in 7 cups of @ricekrispiestreatsus 
Mix together, then spread the mixture across a greased piece of wax paper. Spread it out in a rectangle shape about a 1/2 inch thick.

Then melt one package of chocolate chips in the microwave at 30 second intervals stirring between each time. 
Spread the chocolate over the rice krispies. Then roll them up like you do with cinnamon rolls. Wrap the log in wax paper and let chill in the fridge. Then cut into slices!

Shepherds ￼ Pie Recipe
Crisp 1/2 lb bacon in a large frying pan.
Leave a small amount of grease in the pan 
sauté 4 diced carrots, diced onion, and a half stalk celery diced.
Once onions are translucent sauté 6 cloves minced garlic until fragrant.
Add 2lbs ground beef and cook all the way through. Drain all the grease. 
Add salt, pepper, four pats of butter, and one 6oz can tomato paste and mix.
Add a 16oz can of dark (or light) ale beer, 1 TBL Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary, 1 tsp oregano and a small bag of frozen peas.
Let this simmer long and slow until it's the thickness you like. I like to simmer out almost all the liquid.
Top with mashed potatoes. Mix in shredded sharp white cheddar for a beautiful flavor!
Add your potatoes to the top of your meat mixture and bake at 375° for about 20 min or until it looks golden.

chop the following veggies and add to a pan
Yellow Onion
.5 lbs cherry tomatoes (no need to chop)
vine tomatoes about 7
red bell pepper
Cut the end off a whole bulb of garlic
Generously drizzle with Olive Oil, Salt, Pepper, Oregano, and Thyme.
Roast in the oven at °450 for 45 min.
Once everything cools add to a blender with fresh basil and squeeze out the garlic. You can add chicken broth to make the soup go further as well.
Once blended you can add it to a pot and warm on the stove top. Serve with a spoon full of heavy cream.

ezapJH6TDW8.description:
My dress linked here: https://bit.ly/45SOpHO

Lincoln's Baptism had been on the books for months. We actually had a hard time getting it scheduled and needed special approval to have it on this particular day. Little did we know everything in our lives would change just days before Lincolns Baptism. I did not know if I would be able to put on my strong Mom face and make it a special day for Lincoln. I wanted to cancel it, but I knew that wouldn't have been fair for Lincoln. As I sat there in tears I thought to myself "This is hard, but the timing is actually perfect. I get to leave everything for a few hours and focus on the gift that Jesus Christ has given us. The gift of forgiveness, and the gift to make up where we lack"

Dh5Y96YYtnU.description:
It's funny how sometimes our prayers are answered in ways we don't expect, like through a failure or mistake. Joel recently failed an inspection due to using the wrong wiring in the bathrooms of our new home. While fixing this, he discovered that a wall had all the electrical running through it, but it wasn't connected to the home run. If he had passed the inspection, he wouldn't have realized the issue and we would have been left with no power on that wall. It's interesting to think about how failures and mistakes can lead us to solutions we may have never discovered otherwise.

Honey Lime Tacos Recipe:
For the chicken put 2lbs of chicken in a crockpot with 1 jar of herdez salsa verde
1/2 cup honey
The juice and zest of 2 limes
I don’t measure seasonings, so add to your liking
Chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. 
Cook on low for about 5 hours, then shred.

In a pan with a little butter,  use small tortillas, add mozzarella cheese and the chicken. Fold in half and cook till crisp on both sides. I put the finished tacos in a warm oven until I have them all made.

On a plate layer a bed of shredded lettuce, fresh pico, guacamole, sour cream, then your tacos!!!

Teriyaki Chicken
Cut up chicken breast and let Marinate in the following:
6 oz can Pineapple juice
1 TBL Hoisin sauce 
1/2 bottle teriyaki sauce
4 cloves minced Garlic
1 Onion chopped
3 TBL Soy sauce 
1 TBL Sweet chili sauce
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce 
1 TBL fish sauce
Grill one side of the chicken, baste with marinate, then flip and grill the other side. When chicken is done put in a container with butter and a little extra teriyaki sauce and let rest for 10 min.

JUjx4Rvd7oE.description:
This was such a weird day. It really felt like a blur and as I tried to document it I dont feel like I captured how the day truly was. It felt like we were in shock a little. I know that sounds dramatic and that was part of our mixed emotions. We travel a lot and so I felt like I didnt have the right to be sad, since there are so many other worse things in the world, ya know. 
I think I felt the most bad for my Dad. He was so excited to go, and it was our last trip before they leave on a mission for 2 years. In the grand scheme of things we are fine, but it did hit us pretty hard. Especially knowing half our family still got on the ship and had to leave.

Bostons Talk
This year for the 4th of July, I tried mutton Bustin. 
My Mom told me how to hold on the sheep with all my strength.
She said what ever you do “ DON’T LET GO NO MATTER WHAT”
My mom really believed that I could win, and it made me believe it to.
On my first ride of the sheep I held on as tight as I could.
But the sheep did a front roll over my entire body and I fell off.
Getting a 59 point score.
On my second ride I rode the sheep backwards.
I was able to hold on for almost 10 seconds this time.
I got a score of 96 points that time.
The announcer said the names of the top three riders and I was 3rd place.
I have never been so happy, I even got a trophy.
My mom believed in me and I was able to be a winner.
Heavenly Father believes in us the same way.
He has told us how to hold on to the gospel with all our strength.
He tells us “ don’t let go no matter what ”
With the example of my family, and the gift of the Holy Ghost,
I have the help and strength needed to always hold onto the gospel
Even if I get rolled over again I can always get back on 
and keep on riding.

Coconut Curry Soup:
Sautee 1 diced onion

Add in minced garlic and ginger. Sautee a little longer.

Add 2 cans of coconut milk, 1 can of chicken broth, 30oz red curry paste, and whisk together. I like mine more runny so I will fill a can with water and add that too.

Add all veggies and boil until soft. Not to soft. 
Potatoes, carrots, bell pepper, cauliflower, broccoli. Anything you want.

When veggies are soft, remove from heat and add in chopped cilantro, green opinion, the zest and juice of 2 large limes, a can of pineapple and as much spinach as you want.  If you use fresh pineapple (which taste so much better, add when the veggies are halfway done)

Pumpkin Cheese Cake Recipe:
Ingredients
Crust:
1 3/4 cups graham cracker crumbs
3 tablespoons light brown sugar
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 stick melted salted butter
Filling:
3 (8-ounce) packages cream cheese, at room temperature
1 (15-ounce) can pureed pumpkin
3 eggs plus 1 egg yolk
1/4 cup sour cream
1 1/2 cups sugar
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/8 teaspoon fresh ground nutmeg
1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
2 tablespoon all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

For crust:

In medium bowl, combine crumbs, sugar and cinnamon. Add melted butter. Press down flat into a 9-inch springform pan. Set aside.

For filling:

Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add pumpkin puree, eggs, egg yolk, sour cream, sugar and the spices. Add flour and vanilla. Beat together until well combined.

Pour into crust. Spread out evenly and place in oven for 1 hour. Remove from the oven and let sit for 15 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours.

Recipe courtesy Paula Deen
